{"step":6,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_get_lazychunk","line":1947,"var":"block_csizes","code":"int32_t* block_csizes = malloc(nblocks * sizeof(int32_t));","note":"A second heap buffer stores synthesized per-block sizes."},
{"step":7,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_get_lazychunk","line":1957,"var":"csize_idx","code":"qsort(csize_idx, nblocks, sizeof(struct csize_idx), &sort_offset);","note":"The offsets from the frame are reordered to infer block boundaries."},

{"step":9,"file":"blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_get_lazychunk","line":1970,"var":"trailer_csizes","code":"memcpy(trailer_csizes, block_csizes, nblocks * sizeof(int32_t));","note":"The synthesized sizes are stored in the returned lazy chunk, setting up the invalid-free observed in the crash state."}
